Hero.heading: Hi, my name is Felipe Pêpe.
Hero.intro_2: working across the full stack, with an entrepreneurial spirit and a passion for projects involving software, creativity, and challenges.

About.title: About me
About.about_0: I am a software engineer based in Rio de Janeiro and am completing my degree in Computer and Information Engineering at UFRJ. My professional experience includes developing web platforms with Next.js, NestJS, Node.js, and Ruby on Rails, as well as system integrations, automated testing, and performance improvements.
About.about_1: What I love about my work is being able to use
About.about_2: and knowledge to build new projects and
About.about_3: . There is nothing better than implementing a new feature, overcoming its challenges, and seeing the end user benefit from what we have created. That is what motivates me!
About.about_4: Outside of technology, I enjoy games and cinema and work in theater, where I have also been exploring directing. The art of storytelling is an important part of who I am.

Experience.title: Experience
Experience.1_desc1: Developed features for the Witseed platform using Next.js, TypeScript, and Ruby on Rails.
Experience.1_desc2: Investigated and resolved incidents, created prototypes, and wrote technical documentation.
Experience.2_desc1: Developed and maintained the Witseed by Exame corporate education platform using Next.js, Node.js, and Ruby on Rails.
Experience.2_desc2: Built APIs and implemented authentication integrations, including corporate SSO.
Experience.2_desc3: Served as the technical point of contact in client meetings to define SSO integrations.
Experience.2_desc4: Collaborated with Product and support teams to define features and resolve client requests.
Experience.3_desc1: Developed internal platforms at SomaLabs for creating, editing, viewing, and approving the group's brand collections using Next.js and NestJS.
Experience.3_desc2: Implemented an edit history feature, registration forms for raw materials and artwork, and image integration between systems.
Experience.3_desc3: Integrated product data with Linx to make it available to other company systems, including the e-commerce platform.
Experience.3_desc4: Refactored pages to use server-side rendering and streaming in Next.js, displaying content before large volumes of data had finished loading.
Experience.3_desc5: Created applications, configured error monitoring with Sentry, and implemented automated tests with Vitest.

Projects.title: Projects
Projects.sc_desc1: A website created while studying React Server Components and how they work in Next.js. The project includes practical examples of Server and Client Components.
Projects.sc_desc2: For now, the project is available only in Portuguese.
Projects.stiks_desc1: An online guessing game to play with friends on the web! The game is an adaptation of Purrinha, a Brazilian bar game. It is a personal project that will receive regular updates.
Projects.stiks_desc2: I decided to build this project entirely on my own. To do so, I studied WebSockets, UI design, UX design, non-relational databases, and other topics. It was a rewarding challenge that required a lot of creativity, dedication, and organization.
Projects.criasound_desc1: I developed the landing pages for criasound, a music and artistic experience lab.
Projects.personal_site_desc1: The previous version of this very site! I built this project following the official Next.js guides. It is no longer live, but the code is available on my GitHub.
Projects.job_searcher_desc: A tool for searching LinkedIn jobs based on the use of logical operators in search queries. This project is a Single Page Application (SPA) in which I used widely adopted libraries and important React features, such as the Context API.
Projects.enigmle_desc: A daily puzzle game! Every day, a new puzzle challenges players' knowledge and research skills. My favorite project.
